For NA=0.5, the low-aberration field of view is restricted to less than 5 µm in the visible range, making single-element metalenses unsuitable for high-performance wide-field imaging compared to multi-element objectives."},{"path":"/source_materials/0/deep_read_material/question_material/10/examples/0/finding","quote":"对于数值孔径 NA = 0.5、焦距 f = 1 mm 的单层透镜，在可见光波段，若要求路径延迟误差不超过一个波长（即低像差范围），其视场被限制在小于 5 µm 的范围内。这一极小的视场意味着单层界面透镜适用于点对点互连，但不适用于高性能成像。"}]}]}
